# Add retries with backoff to the upload client

## Summary

Retries transient upload failures (network resets, 429s, 5xx) with
exponential backoff and jitter, up to a configurable limit. Permanent
errors such as 400 and 403 still fail on the first attempt.

## Why

The upload client has no retry logic, so on any error we just fail, even
for gateway blips that clear within a second. Support tickets about
"random upload failures" have doubled since the CDN migration.

## How

- `RetryPolicy` holds max attempts, base delay and a jitter factor
- `UploadClient::send` wraps each attempt and classifies the error
- Retry-After headers win over the computed delay when present

## Stacked on

- #412 (error classification in the HTTP layer)

## Testing

- [x] Unit tests for the delay schedule
- [ ] Ran the integration suite
- [ ] Manually killed the network mid-upload
